research_conclusion.statement: This release implements immutable ingestion and a PIT FY0/FY1 feature prototype only; target scoring, historical vintage proof, coverage qualification and return validation remain blocked.

source.documented_pagination: limit=3000 and offset=N*3000 until a short or empty page

permission.reason: A full historical backfill is not feasible under the observed trial rate and daily allowance.

raw_contract.publication: All pages must complete before normalized page Parquets, the combined Parquet and a page-bound manifest are written to one staging directory and atomically renamed.
raw_contract.resume: An existing partition is reused only when endpoint, field order, schema, combined Parquet row count/SHA-256, exact page-file set, every page file SHA/content hash/row count/offset and provider total row count are recomputed and match.
raw_contract.pagination_rule: Every request sends limit=3000 and an explicit offset. A full 3000-row page requires another rate-limited page; only a short or empty page completes the date.
raw_contract.pagination_blocks: A page over 3000, a repeated page content hash, any exact source row repeated across pages, unsupported limit/offset, a request failure, conflicting identity across pages, or 100 consecutive full pages blocks without publication.
raw_contract.maturity: Only report dates strictly before the current Asia/Shanghai calendar date may be published; the current date waits until the provider's documented 19:00-22:00 update window has fully passed.
raw_contract.dedupe: Exact source-row duplicates are removed deterministically; conflicting rows with the same report identity block normalization.

pit_contract.availability: first official exchange open session strictly after report_date
pit_contract.correction_policy: Previously published raw partitions are immutable; changed or malformed partitions block instead of being overwritten.
pit_contract.calendar_requirement: The supplied official calendar must extend through the next open session after every report_date.

feature_contract.state: latest available report per stock, target quarter and broker; same-broker same-report-date duplicates use a frozen per-metric median and never create_time or content-hash ordering
feature_contract.target_quarters: Only calendar-year FY0 Q4 and FY1 Q4 are emitted for each signal date; stale historical quarters, non-Q4 quarters and FY2+ are excluded.
feature_contract.missing_policy: Insufficient paired brokers or missing estimates produce NaN; missing values are never replaced with zero.

candidate_families: FY0/FY1 NP consensus revision at frozen 20/60-session horizons, with EPS as a split/share-adjustment robustness check
FY1 versus FY0 consensus forecast growth on the same paired brokers
actual announced earnings versus the last pre-announcement consensus
research_spec_before_returns.selection_rule: No family may load returns until fiscal mapping, expiry, broker normalization, coverage and one-dimensional stock-score formulas are versioned and hash-bound.

sync_plan.date_axis: all calendar report dates, including immutable empty partitions
sync_plan.request_count_note: This is a lower bound of one request per calendar date; full pages require additional page and terminal-short-page requests.

event_anchors.availability: first official open session strictly after ann_date

parallel_opportunity_set_experiment.purpose: Test whether the Top500 opportunity set, rather than another score transformation, is the binding constraint.
parallel_opportunity_set_experiment.selection_data_cutoff: 2024-12-31 physical files before any expanded-universe return evaluation
challenger_universes: all PIT-eligible A-shares with trailing-20-session RMB ADV >= 100000000
the top 1500 PIT-eligible A-shares by trailing-20-session RMB ADV
eligibility: listed for at least 120 official trading sessions
not ST on the signal date under historical-name PIT data
not delisted and has valid next-open execution inputs
same 50000000 capital, 5000000 target position notional and 5% ADV capacity rule
parallel_opportunity_set_experiment.fixed_components: Use the unchanged fixed-core score, Top10/exit25 retention, ten offsets, next-open execution and full costs; do not add a selector or change weights.
parallel_opportunity_set_experiment.audit_rule: Do not open 2025+ for a challenger that fails the frozen train and validation gates.

promotion_gates: Upgrade report_rc permission and finish an uncapped immutable backfill from 2017.

Pass schema, identity, broker-alias, calendar and monthly FY0/FY1 three-paired-broker coverage audits.
Freeze active-reviser semantics, fiscal expiry and the one-dimensional score for all three candidate families before loading returns.
Run exact next-open full-cost validation without changing this feature family.
